dct_description_sm: The objective of this study was to determine the effect of a milk by-product based feed treatment compared to a conventional grain-based ration on feed intakes, rumen development, and growth of heifer calves fed two different levels of milk. This data is from mixed linear models, with the data presented for treatments separated by factor (milk treatment and feed treatment) rather than the treatment interactions.
dct_title_s: Supplementary material: Effect of a milk by-product based calf starter feed on dairy calf nutrient consumption, rumen development, and performance when fed different milk levels
